findings: All 8 modules + types created per design, no file splits needed (largest: pod-template-diff-utils.ts 226 lines). Tests: 8 new files / 99 tests pass; full suite 34 files / 254 tests; tsc exit 0; eslint clean on all new files and view-labels.ts. Exports match the design signatures; additions beyond the design (harmless): deployment-rollout-utils exports `PdbSummary` (the summarizePdb return type, structurally identical to the inline design type); live-refresh-decision exports `LiveRefreshState` ({ lastLiveRv?: string; hadLive: boolean }). Gotchas for later FEATs: (1) FEAT-004 RevisionDiffModal/DeploymentDetails: build RevisionYamlInput as { revision: rev.revision, name: rev.name, createdAt: rev.creationTimestamp (pass the Date unchanged, getDeploymentRevisions returns a Date via IPC), replicas: rev.spec?.replicas, selector: rev.spec?.selector, template: rev.spec?.template } - that is byte-identical to the old helper (test 'is byte-identical to the old modal helper' contains a verbatim copy of the old helper as the oracle). (2) maskTemplateEnv uses a custom structural deepClone that preserves Date instances (not JSON/structuredClone) so YAML output stays identical; it masks only literal `value`s, never valueFrom. (3) sensitive-value-utils and label-selector-utils import only `import type` from ../types/deployment-details, so electron/ can import them (LAST_APPLIED, selectorToQueryString, matchesLabelSelector, matchesServiceSelector). (4) diffPodTemplates label formats: image/scalar/resources/probes use `<field> <container>: before → after` (e.g. 'image app: v1 → v2', 'resources.limits.memory app: 256Mi → 512Mi'), added `<field> <container> added: X`, removed `<field> <container> removed (was X)`; env uses 'env X added' / 'env X removed' / 'env X: a → b' / 'env X changed (value hidden)'; whole containers 'container X added (image)' / 'container X removed'; restartedAt change is emitted first as 'Rollout restart triggered'. Empty arrays/objects are treated as unset. (5) buildRevisionTimeline: when the deployment revision annotation exists but matches no RS it falls through to the pod-hash then highest-revision rule; when no entry has a numeric revision the last (newest createdAt) entry is current. getPreviousRevision returns null for unnumbered entries. eventsForRevision token-matches only events with involvedKind === 'Deployment'. (6) getRolloutSummary: Recreate strategy reports maxSurge/maxUnavailable null; observedGenerationStale treats a missing observedGeneration as 0 when metadata.generation is set. summarizeHpa metric target strings: Utilization '80%', AverageValue '500Mi (avg)', Value raw; current null when no matching currentMetrics entry. (7) view-labels: parseDeploymentDetailViewId also rejects ids whose decoded segment is empty.
